Zhuge Liang does not step back, lips closed.

Zhuge Liang's LEFT hand holds the white feather fan, never in front of his mouth. Natural rapid rap articulation, head nods and shoulder drive on the beat, eyes locked on the opponent. Expressive but controlled arm gestures. Audience remains outside the battle circle. Keep both men distinct. No extra fingers, no changing props, no internal cuts, no written words or watermarks.
